hypothesis: The P70_L40d adaptive ATR filter selected in EXP-0010 holds on a fully out-of-sample test year (2025) that was not used in threshold selection.

frozen_config.filter: current ATR > 70th percentile of trailing 3000-bar (~40 trading day) ATR
frozen_config.source: EXP-0010 best config — frozen before this experiment

train_reference: Jan 2023 – Dec 2024 (24 months, in-sample reference only)
pass_criterion: >= 65% of OOS months beat baseline (8 of 12)

FINDING-1.title: Filter PASSES OOS at 67% (8/12 months) — above the 65% threshold
FINDING-1.detail: The P70_L40d filter, frozen from EXP-0010 without any re-fitting, beats baseline in 8 of 12 blind test months. OOS avg return jumps from +56.3% (baseline) to +74.4% (adaptive). This validates the adaptive approach as genuinely predictive, not just in-sample fitting.

FINDING-2.title: April 2025 standout: +317.8% adaptive vs +202.4% baseline
FINDING-2.detail: April 2025 (avg ATR 28.4 pts) was a strong trending month. The filter kept the strategy in the best regime bands and amplified already-strong baseline returns significantly. The avg P&L per trade was ₹1,718 — the highest in the test set.

FINDING-3.title: 4 OOS failures are months where baseline strongly outperforms
FINDING-3.detail: Failures: Jan 2025 (+128.7% baseline vs +43.2% filtered), Mar 2025 (+63.6% vs +25.9%), Sep 2025 (+67.4% vs -2.8%), Oct 2025 (+101.3% vs +69.8%). These are months where the unfiltered strategy captured a strong trending environment that the adaptive filter partially restricted. Sep 2025 is the most concerning: adaptive turned a +67.4% baseline into -2.8%. This suggests the filter occasionally restricts the right trades in strong trending markets.

FINDING-4.title: Filter rescues badly losing months: Nov 2025 (+58.1% vs -11.3%), Dec 2025 (+46.1% vs -46.5%)
FINDING-4.detail: Nov/Dec 2025 had below-average ATR (~18-19 pts). The adaptive filter identified relative volatility pockets within those quiet months and traded them selectively, turning large baseline losses into gains.

leakage_check.threshold_selection: Config (P70, 3000 bars) was frozen before running on 2025 data — no re-fitting occurred
leakage_check.rolling_quantile: At each bar, only past bars used in quantile computation

conclusion: HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. P70_L40d adaptive ATR filter PASSES walk-forward validation on 2025 OOS data (67%, above 65% threshold). OOS avg return: +74.4%/month vs +56.3% baseline. The filter adds +18pp/month on average while protecting against large losing months. 4 failures are 'acceptable losses' — months where baseline was strongly positive and the filter was conservative. Sep 2025 (-2.8% vs +67.4%) is the one genuinely concerning failure to monitor. The adaptive ATR filter is now the VALIDATED primary regime filter for ASTRA. Status: ready for Monte Carlo stress testing.
status_change: Phase gate: advance from WALK_FORWARD to MONTE_CARLO for adaptive filter
